At tick 8: P=8, S=6, update marker u1.
Immediate-read channel returned 6 at tick 8.

After reset and fold=2 at tick 7, the same P=8, S=6, u1 state was recorded at tick 8.

observations.statement: Before run one, the queue contained batch B3 with three payload items and the acknowledgement register was empty.
Run one recorded three payload deliveries by tick 2.
Run one recorded acknowledgement green at tick 3.
The system was reset; the same batch B3 was placed into the empty queue.
Run two recorded three payload deliveries by tick 2.
Run two recorded acknowledgement register empty at tick 4.
The watchdog state changed to expired at tick 4, and no later acknowledgement event was recorded for run two.

objects.statement: Payload queue holds batches (observed batch B3).
Acknowledgement register records acknowledgement state (observed empty, green).
Four-tick watchdog records a state (observed expired).
Batch B3 carries three payload items and was reused across runs.

boundaries: No claim that the watchdog caused the missing acknowledgement.

obligations: Additional evidence needed: the register write trace around tick 4 in run two (before vs after write).
Additional evidence needed: watchdog-to-register interaction log.
